check_training: test distributed training with a specific model dtype like bf16 using accelerate launch
check_mixed_precision: test mixed-precision training where the model is fp32 but compute runs in bf16 or fp16
check_gradient_accumulation: test distributed training with gradient accumulation steps to verify correct behavior
check_resume: test that training can resume from a checkpoint with consistent learning rates across runs
check_eval: test that distributed evaluation produces a finite eval loss metric in the output file
